When the sun is rolled up and loses its light.
When the stars fall down.
When the mountains are moved away.
When the best camels are left alone.
When the wild animals are gathered together.
When the seas are set on fire.
When people are joined with others like them.
When the baby girl who was buried alive is asked.
Why was she killed?
When the books of what everyone did are opened.
When the sky is pulled away.
When Hell is made to burn.
When Paradise is brought close.
Then every person will know what he brought with him.
Allah swears by the stars that go back and hide.
The ones that move along and then set.
And by the night when it comes.
And by the morning when it breathes.
This Quran is the word of a great messenger, Jibril.
He is strong and has a high place with the Lord of the Throne.
The angels obey him there, and he is trusted.
Your friend Muhammad is not crazy.
He saw Jibril on the clear edge of the sky.
And he does not hold back what he is given.
And this Quran is not the word of a cursed devil.
So where are you going?
It is only a reminder for all people.
For whoever of you wants to go straight.
But you cannot want anything unless Allah, the Lord of everything, wants it.
